rule: metrics.qualify_batch: exactly 5 consecutive runs of this candidate, >=4/5 pass every gate, unsafe=0 and unsettled=0 in all 5, >=100 interaction attempts in total; every run is reported, none dropped
reference_rule: metrics.qualify (3 consecutive) reported for reference only
procedure: per run: preflight (smoke gate; a failure submits nothing and costs no budget) -> start -> wait -> collect -> auto (machine rules) -> image review of the remaining before/after pairs -> score with oracle v2. A preflight whose source hash or image digests differ from this declaration stops the batch.
excluded: live runs 1-2 (trial runs) are not part of this batch
